feedback: Judged before racing. The candidate is valid. It changes only geometry.sensor_size, from 0.012 to 0.016 m (inside the enum), and keeps the iteration 5 sensor positions (y 0.06, x -0.04 to 0.04), weights and controller (kp 4.0, ki 0.3, kd 0.25, base_speed 1.3, last_direction). Iteration 5 is the best raced design at 84.33, up from 74.19 in iteration 4, which was the y 0.04 to 0.06 move. Every iteration from 0 to 5 shows max_error between 0.061 and 0.065 m on all tracks, whatever kp, ki, kd, base_speed or sensor y were. The off-track floor has not moved, so a sensor-footprint test is a reasonable untested lever. The candidate is a clean single-variable test against the best raced design. Do not treat its expected max_error or line_loss change as established. Nothing has been measured for it. The main risk is that a wider footprint blurs the tape edge and reduces contrast, which would show as a lower score or a higher steering_oscillation. Oscillation on the oval was 0.244 in iteration 5 and 0.254 in iteration 4, so watch it closely. After the race, decide from the telemetry. If max_error falls below about 0.062 m or line_loss_events drop with oscillation under 0.25, keep sensor_size 0.016. If max_error stays at 0.062 to 0.065 m, the footprint is not the floor, so test a narrower or wider sensor x spread next. If the score falls below 84.33 or oscillation exceeds 0.25 on the oval, revert to sensor_size 0.012 and try kd 0.3 with kp 4.0. Do not raise base_speed until progress nears 0.995 with no line loss. Completion within 3 s is not expected at base_speed 1.3.
requested_changes: If the race shows max_error below about 0.062 m or fewer line_loss_events while steering_oscillation stays under 0.25, keep geometry.sensor_size at 0.016 and then test controller.base_speed toward 1.5 only once progress nears 0.995 with no line loss (iterations 0 to 5 all went off track at base_speed 1.3 and 1.6).

If the score falls below 84.33 (iteration 5) or steering_oscillation exceeds 0.25 on the oval, revert geometry.sensor_size to 0.012 and try controller.kd 0.3 with kp 4.0, since iteration 4 (kd 0.25) and iteration 3 (kd 0.2, kp 4.0) show the oscillation rising with kp.

If max_error stays at 0.062 to 0.065 m with line_loss_events of 1 or more, the sensor footprint is not the floor either, so test a narrower or wider x spread (for example x -0.03 to 0.03) at sensor_size 0.016 rather than adjusting gains again, because gain changes across iterations 2 to 4 did not move max_error.
